# GobyMeds

> GobyMeds is a telemedicine platform offering personalized weight loss and anti-aging treatments including GLP-1 medications (semaglutide, tirzepatide), peptide therapies (sermorelin), and longevity solutions (NAD+).

GobyMeds provides online consultations and compounded medication options for metabolic health, weight management, and anti-aging wellness. The platform combines telemedicine convenience with personalized treatment plans and expert educational content.
